decisions.reason: As a large expanding firm with R&D capacity and slack in a growing market, we would keep this adjacent workstation because its fit with the established marking portfolio justifies more time to learn about demand before reallocating resources.

We would keep this thermal inkjet printer because it is very close to our core offer, supports the strategy of application-specific coding solutions, and there is no clear performance shortfall yet relative to aspirations.

We would keep this piezo inkjet printer because it broadens our high-resolution coding range in line with our in-house development strategy, and under uncertainty a well-resourced firm would continue observing results rather than drop it quickly.
